Market today: The Democrat sweep is making markets rethink interest rates, which is a huge driver for your tech-heavy book. Meanwhile, data center scrutiny in Texas and globally is a headwind for chip demand.

Your holdings: Almost everything is on 'SELL' status. SOXL (-81.82%), MUU (-66.07%), PLTU (-35.9%), SMCI (-38.29%), and SMH (-29.64%) are all deep in the red. The leveraged ETFs are particularly concerning given their decay and your margin account, which amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on how the market interprets the interest rate outlook and any further news on data center development and regulation.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk on your leveraged, deeply underwater positions.
plays: Immediately re-evaluate stops on all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, PLTU, METU, SPAL); many are far from current prices, amplifying margin risk.
Consider trimming positions like SOXL (-81.82%) and MUU (-66.07%) to reduce margin exposure and free up capital.
Watch LMT for a potential long entry at 575.58-575.01 with a stop at 574.15, supported by defense sector news.
